name: single leg stretch (bent knee) v. 2
description: A Pilates ab move with alternating knee pulls that builds core endurance and coordination.
instructions: Lie on your back and curl your head and shoulders off the mat.
Pull one knee toward your chest, with hands on that shin.
Extend the other leg long at a low angle.
Switch legs in a steady rhythm.
Keep your lower back anchored to the mat.
